_comment: Registered metrics for road-to-token-economy-dispatch Phase 1 (registered BEFORE any reduction lever ships — the budget-ownership discipline of hook-latency-budget.json / preamble-payload-budget.json). Baseline anchor: road-to-cache-economy census 2026-07-30 (median subagent cold start 235.5k tokens written-or-uncached, C-1 cold-start dominance 69.7%). Thresholds are the roadmap's committed numbers; changing one is a PR citing evidence, never a drive-by edit.

dispatch_floor.definition: Median init_tokens per role (worker, reviewer) and the COST-shaped init/work ratio per dispatched leg. init_tokens = billable_input of the leg's FIRST assistant record (raw — comparable to the cache-economy 235.5k baseline); work_tokens = leg total billable_input minus init_tokens. The RATIO is computed on weighted input units (read 0.1x, 5m write 1.25x, 1h write 2.0x — _lib/cc_transcript.ts weightedInputUnits), NOT raw billable_input: raw counts every later turn's cache-read re-transmission at full weight, which makes the 'more spent loading than working' threshold unmeetable by construction (measured live 2026-08-10: raw ratio 0.02 on the same legs). billable_input = input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens (never usage.input_tokens alone).
dispatch_floor.source: Primary: transcript ledger via src/scripts/_lib/cc_transcript.ts (per-agentId legs, message.id+requestId dedupe). Secondary: audit-log orchestration lines carrying init_tokens/work_tokens with floor_provenance=measured.
dispatch_floor.role_attribution: HONEST LIMITATION until the role axis (Phase 2) ships: transcripts carry no session role, so all subagent legs report as role=worker; reviewer legs are attributed from audit-line agent_combo where present. The report states which attribution produced each number.

thresholds._projection_mandatory: sustained median init/work ratio > 1.0 for rung-1 workers over a review window makes Phase 3 (worker thin projection) mandatory, not optional
thresholds._success: median ratio < 0.15 after Phase 3 ships is the roadmap's registered success criterion

baseline.source: road-to-cache-economy first-party measurement (14-day window, host CC 2.1.220); re-measure on the post-9.29 tree is Phase 1's first report run

return_channel.definition: Orchestrator context growth per dispatch (roadmap Phase 6.3): serialized chars of the tool result returned into the parent context (return_channel_chars on sync completions, hook-carried). The failure this number exists to catch: the isolation win refunded through the return channel.
return_channel.source: orchestration_record_hook.ts on post_tool_use Agent/Task completions; a count derived from the result object, never its content.

thresholds._cap: the committed MAX_ENVELOPE_CHARS from _lib/subagent_response.ts — a median return above it over the review window means transcript-shaped returns are flowing back and the envelope discipline is not holding

projection_quality.definition: Kill criterion for the worker thin projection (roadmap Phase 3.4, REGISTERED before the projection exists): worker verify-fail rate on projected sessions vs the pre-projection baseline.
projection_quality.source: Orchestration lines' dispatch_outcome + verify_mode on role-marked sessions, compared against the same window pre-projection.

thresholds._kill: verify-fail rate exceeding the pre-projection baseline by more than 5 percentage points over a 2-week review window reverts the projection for that rung and the regression is published (roadmap 3.4)

projection_quality.status: armed-awaiting-projection: Phase 3.1-3.3 are data-window-gated (>= 2 weeks of rules_used); this criterion binds the moment a projection ships

ask_economy.definition: Rung-0.5 substitution and adoption (roadmap Phase 4.4): substitution = ask-routed lines / (ask-routed + rung-1 spawn lines); adoption = ask lines with dispatch_outcome DONE / all ask lines; escalation = the caller's follow-up SPAWN lines carrying route_taken=subagent + escalated=true + origin=dispatch-economy-2026 (the ask line itself cannot know it was insufficient).
ask_economy.source: Audit-log orchestration lines with route_taken='ask' (written by src/scripts/ask_transport.ts, origin tag dispatch-economy-2026).

thresholds._kill: if more than 30% of asks over the review window are re-asked or escalated to spawns, the rung's signals tighten or the rung dies — by evidence, in a PR (roadmap 4.4)

rules_efficiency.definition: rules_used / rules_carried per worker envelope (fields shipped by road-to-lean-agent-init, validated in _lib/orchestration_record.ts). Sustained low quota is simultaneously the Phase 3 cut-line evidence AND the demand-signal datum later/road-to-deferred-rule-retriever gate (2c) asks for — one measurement, two consumers.
rules_efficiency.source: Audit-log orchestration lines (agents/runtime/state/audit/*.jsonl) where both fields are non-null.

thresholds._low_quota: a sustained median quota below 0.2 over the review window is the cut-line evidence Phase 3.1 requires (>= 2 weeks of data) and the retriever gate's demand signal

rules_efficiency.classification_note: Classified 2026-08-23 by road-to-trigger-delivered-rule-bodies step 0.8, which requires exactly one of miswired / pre-intervention-impossible / stale before anything is changed. NOT miswired: the report path works and 755 orchestration lines in agents/runtime/state/audit/2026-08.jsonl carry both fields, null on every one, because orchestration_record.ts:146-147 reads them from --rules-carried / --rules-used CLI flags that no caller anywhere passes. NOT stale: the question it asks is exactly the one a delivery mode makes answerable. IMPOSSIBLE: `rules_used` is 'rules the worker actually applied/cited' (contexts/execution/orchestration-telemetry.md:68), a model self-report, and under an eager projection there is no runtime consumer of rule bodies to instrument -- nothing can distinguish a rule that was applied from one that was merely present. The metric is left registered rather than deleted so this reasoning stays attached to it, and it no longer gates anything: later/road-to-deferred-rule-retriever condition (c) now reads the trigger-MATCH rate (rules_matched / rules_carried, produced by src/scripts/model_rule_injection), which is an event the delivery concern performs rather than a claim the model makes. The match rate is explicitly NOT relabelled as usage: matched-and-delivered is not applied-and-followed, and calling it usage would make the retriever's own demand gate self-fulfilling. Evidence: agents/evidence/analysis/trigger-delivery-baseline.md section 7.

honest_null_consequence: If the re-measured floor on the post-9.29 tree is materially smaller than the cache-economy baseline (roadmap step 1.4), phases 3-5 of road-to-token-economy-dispatch downgrade to blockers citing the null, and the null is published in docs/benchmark.md. A metric nobody re-runs by review_by is treated as the latency file's fossilization failure: the report command below is the re-verification procedure.
